No spec change. The remaining failures are not ETL logic errors:
1. drug_exposure.drug_source_concept_id and death.cause_source_concept_id are 0 for every record, which fails sourceConceptRecordCompleteness. The source values are local labels with no concept in the OMOP vocabularies. Fixing this properly means creating site-specific source concepts (concept_id >= 2,000,000,000) for the SRC_DRUG and SRC_VA_CAUSE labels, which is a curation decision for the data owner.
2. drug_exposure.drug_source_value: 2 of 11 distinct drug names are unmapped. Both are too rare to be shown to me (each has fewer than 5 records, so both groups were withheld), so they were never sent for automated mapping. A reviewer should map them in mappings/SRC_DRUG.csv and run `omop-agent apply-mappings`.
3. death.cause_source_value is flagged for the same reason as (1). The causes of death do map to standard concepts: fewer than 5 death records, if any, have cause_concept_id 0.
None of these are blocking (convention severity).
